terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: Dev Express server (server.js) serving the static site and the /api/* endpoints on port 3000. PORT is set explicitly so it does not depend on a local .env (.env is untracked). This is the DEV backend; production forms use PHP handlers (api/*.php) per js/config.js. Email delivery needs real SMTP_* secrets; without them the server logs emails to the console. Repo lint: `npm run validate` (html-validate), `npm run spellcheck` (cspell).
